app.activate.where: Full-screen prompt when the display first opens
app.activate.meaning: Tap once so the display is allowed to play alert sounds.

hdr.kitchen.meaning: "<Venue> · Kitchen" — which venue this screen belongs to.

lang.blocked.meaning: Language did not change because a hold or a save is in progress. Finish that first.

lang.not_saved.meaning: Language changed on this screen but was not saved to the display; it will retry.

status.paired.meaning: "<Display name> · Paired" — this screen is signed in to the venue.

status.not_paired.meaning: This screen is not signed in to any venue and shows no allergies.

offline.banner.meaning: The screen has lost its connection and new allergy alerts are NOT arriving.

board.empty.where: Board when there is nothing to show
board.empty.meaning: No open allergy records for this service.

board.needs.meaning: Records the kitchen has not yet confirmed receiving — act now.
board.needs.concern: Deliberately not literal ("Te necesita"); "Requiere acción" chosen for clarity.

board.working.meaning: Records received and in the kitchen workflow.

board.done.meaning: Records marked served in this service.

board.earlier.meaning: Records from before the current service.

board.earlier_note.meaning: These are not part of the service running now; review them in the Shift Record (an Admin page).
board.earlier_note.concern: "Shift Record" kept in English: it is the name of the Admin page, which is in English.

summary.tables.one.meaning: Count of tables with open records — singular.

summary.tables.other.meaning: Count of tables with open records — plural.

summary.anaphylaxis.meaning: How many open records are anaphylaxis severity.
summary.anaphylaxis.concern: "{n} con anafilaxia" = n records with anaphylaxis severity. Confirm it reads as a count of records, not of people with a diagnosis.

summary.need_action.one.meaning: One record not yet confirmed by the kitchen.

summary.need_action.other.meaning: Several records not yet confirmed by the kitchen.

summary.all_confirmed.meaning: Every open record has been confirmed received.
summary.all_confirmed.concern: "All Confirmed" means all RECEIVED — not that anything is safe. "Todas confirmadas" agrees with "alergias".

row.rehearsal.meaning: This record is from a practice run, not a real guest.

row.updated.meaning: The guest changed this allergy record; this is the newer version.

row.confirm_received.meaning: Hold to confirm the kitchen has received this allergy.

row.confirm_prep.meaning: Hold to confirm the prep area has been cleared and separated.

row.second_check.meaning: Open the Second Check for this record.

row.mark_served.meaning: Hold to record that this dish has left the kitchen.

sev.anaphylaxis.meaning: The guest stated anaphylaxis: the most severe reaction.
sev.anaphylaxis.concern: Medical term "ANAFILAXIA". Confirm kitchen staff recognise it; if not, pair it with a plain word without weakening it.

sev.severe.meaning: The guest stated a severe reaction.

sev.discomfort.meaning: The guest stated discomfort: the mildest stated severity.
sev.discomfort.concern: "MALESTAR" — confirm it reads as neither more nor less serious than "discomfort".

sev.unsure.meaning: The guest did not say how severe the reaction is. Treat the allergy as real.
sev.unsure.concern: NOT "NO SEGURO": "seguro" also means "safe", so "no seguro" reads as "not safe". "GRAVEDAD NO INDICADA" = severity not stated. Confirm.

sev.unknown.meaning: The record has no severity value.

chip.cross_contact.meaning: The guest asked for CROSS-CONTACT precautions: prevent any trace of the allergen reaching their food through shared surfaces, utensils, oil, gloves or hands — not only bacterial contamination.
chip.cross_contact.concern: "CONTACTO CRUZADO" (allergen-specific) vs "contaminación cruzada" (common kitchen term that usually means microbial cross-contamination, a different concept). Do not choose "contaminación cruzada" just because it is familiar; the allergen meaning must survive.

reh.full.where: Top of the record and the lockout
reh.full.meaning: This whole record is a practice run. There is no real guest at this table.
reh.full.concern: GUEST = "huésped" (also in notes.heading, misc.guest). In a restaurant "comensal" or "cliente" may read more naturally; "huésped" leans hotel. Choose one word and use it everywhere.

step.ack.meaning: Current step: the kitchen confirms it has received the allergy.

step.prep.meaning: Current step: confirm the prep area, utensils and surfaces are cleared and separated.
step.prep.concern: "Confirmación de preparación" can read as "the dish was prepared". The step is confirming the PREP AREA was cleared. (The English has the same ambiguity.)

step.verify.meaning: Current step: another team member checks the allergy preparation before the dish leaves.
step.verify.concern: "Segunda revisión", deliberately NOT "verificación": "verificado" reads as "verified safe", a stronger claim than "Second Check".

step.serve.meaning: Current step: record that the dish has left the kitchen.
step.serve.concern: Agreement: "servida" agrees with "la alergia" (the record). If it reads as the dish it should be "servido" (el plato). Decide once — it recurs in row.mark_served, hold.serve, rail.served, err.serve, title.served_done.

step.waiting.meaning: How long the current step has been waiting.

hold.ack.where: Main hold button — record and lockout
hold.ack.meaning: Press and hold to record that the kitchen received this allergy.
hold.ack.concern: "Mantén presionado" (Latin America) vs "Mantén pulsado" (Spain); informal "tú" throughout — confirm the register for kitchen staff.

hold.prep.where: Main hold button — record and lockout
hold.prep.meaning: Press and hold to record that the prep area was cleared and separated.
hold.prep.concern: "despejada" = cleared of things. Must NOT drift toward "limpia/libre de alérgenos" (a claim). Confirm a cook reads it as "cleared and separated".

hold.verify.meaning: Press and hold to record that the Second Check happened.

hold.serve.meaning: Press and hold to record that the dish left the kitchen.

do.ack.meaning: Confirm the kitchen has received this allergy.

do.prep.meaning: Clear and separate the prep area, utensils and surfaces.

do.verify.meaning: Have a different team member check the allergy preparation. (The display cannot prove who did.)

do.serve.meaning: Record served when the dish leaves the kitchen.

do.complete.meaning: All four Kitchen steps are recorded. It says nothing about the guest or the plate.

do.gone.meaning: This record is no longer current work here; nothing was recorded on this screen.

title.record.meaning: An allergy record with no current step.

title.served_done.concern: Awkward ("Servida: registrado"). Needs a native phrasing that says only "served was recorded", and must not imply the guest received or ate it.

title.gone.meaning: This record is no longer on the board.

ok.prep.meaning: The "prep area cleared" step was recorded.

rail.received.meaning: Stage 1 — the allergy reached the kitchen.

ref.avoid_all.meaning: "Avoid all — <allergen>": ingredients that contain or derive from this allergen.
ref.avoid_all.concern: Infinitive "Evitar todo" (sign style) vs imperative "Evita todo". The allergen name after the dash is English data until a canonical allergen vocabulary exists, so the heading is mixed-language by design.

ref.check_ingredients.where: Heading when no reference list exists
ref.check_ingredients.meaning: There is no list for this allergen; check the ingredients yourself.

ref.no_list.meaning: No reference list exists; confirm ingredients before preparing.

ref.untranslated.meaning: Tells the cook the allergen names and lists are in English and were NOT translated.
ref.untranslated.concern: Must state plainly that this data is untranslated. It is shown only when the screen language is not English.

notes.heading.concern: See reh.full on "huésped". "(sin traducir)" is deliberate: guest text is never machine-translated.

prov.line.meaning: "<Display> · <Venue> — records the display, not the person." The screen knows which display acted, never which person.

prov.this_display.meaning: "This display" when the display name is not known yet.

prov.this_venue.meaning: "this venue" before the venue name loads.

lock.next.meaning: The next Kitchen step for this record is the Second Check.

misc.table.meaning: "Table" when a record has no service point.

err.not_paired.meaning: Nothing was recorded: this screen is not paired. Pair it in Set Up (Admin).
err.not_paired.concern: "Set Up" kept in English: it is the Admin menu label.

err.verify.meaning: "Second Check" was NOT recorded. Hold again.

err.minimize.meaning: Hidden on this screen but not saved.

pair.body.meaning: Where to get the 6-digit code in Admin.

pair.done_body.meaning: This display is signed in to the venue; it identifies the display, not the person.
